root_semantics: one stable read transaction after centralized storage/materialization/expected-live-schema admission
application sqlite_schema declaration bound without physical rootpage/internal autoindexes
typed logical values and duplicate multiplicity bound

sqlite_sequence included because future AUTOINCREMENT behavior is causal state

architecture_delta.decision: Use independently derived authoritative UnifiedDB semantic root only at explicit admitted checkpoint/recovery boundaries. Do not create a per-transaction external head. ClayGraph is derived readiness/rebuild state and cannot mint/redefine self.root.
next_required_composition: explicit checkpoint/recovery admission protocol over the attested semantic root
publish admitted root through one selected-head authority using #267 single-winner CAS semantics plus #273 payload/restore semantics
preserve #281/#273 correlated whole-domain rollback limitation unless an out-of-domain monotonic authority is independently proven
keep build provenance as a separate conjunctive owner-pinned gate

external_knowledge_constraints.github_private_attestations: GitHub documentation currently limits private/internal artifact attestations to Enterprise Cloud; actual target plan/service capability is unverified, so production verifier remains provider-neutral/owner-pinned.
external_knowledge_constraints.sqlite_wal_reset: Upstream WAL-reset issue remains a release constraint for unproven affected versions; Ubuntu package suffix alone is not accepted as backport proof.
external_knowledge_constraints.hostinger_whole_vm_restore: Hostinger documentation describes VPS snapshots/restores as whole VPS state rewind. No documented provider guarantee was found for TPM/vTPM monotonic state outside that restore domain. Local TPM presence, if later observed, cannot by itself prove whole-VM rollback safety.

negative_results: same source/identity metadata alone is not unique semantic-state continuity
file replace is not a concurrent single-winner selected-head publication primitive
selected-head locality cannot distinguish a correlated rollback of both state and selector
source migration digest metadata alone did not attest live sqlite_schema; #294 fixed expected-vs-live schema admission
semantic root sensitivity to live writes is not permission to synchronously externalize every transaction
ClayGraph readiness/materialization state is not authoritative self semantic identity
checkpoint-root construction does not itself admit a checkpoint, verify recovery, publish a selected head, or authorize effects
